title: How to Enhance your Mocap/P-Cap Shoot: A Collaborative Guide for Game Devs and Performers
description: This talk centres around the collaboration between the Game Developer and the Performer. Drawing on almost 25 years working in Motion and Performance Capture in over 50 AAA titles, I share my experience on how developers and actors alike can get the most out of their time in the volume. From choosing actors and auditioning, to preparing shot-lists and streamlining schedules.
session_takeaway: Learn how to prepare for and execute a motion capture shoot to achieve optimal data.
How to structure and plan a mocap day that is both actor-friendly and budget-efficient.
Deep dive into acting in the digital realm and communication techniques between devs and actors.
